steps.content: The crimson curtains are drawn open, revealing the seats filled with audience.

steps.speaker: Announcer
steps.content: Coming up next is a solo dance!
Clack. Right after the announcement, the spotlight shoots out a burning beam, scorching the top of your head.
You finally make out the faces in the audience. They're black phantoms gleaming with an eerie, ghostly light, and with a murderous air around them, they're charging at you!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief?
Nightingale's voice pulls you back to reality.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: According to your request, the FAC has sent as many forces as possible and the contamination has mostly been cleaned up.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But the issue you're concerned about most, the Sinner Hamel, her...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Her mental state is not very stable.
...For 23 years, she's been living among Corruptors and dancing ceaselessly in the illusory realm, without any concept of time. Of course, she can't cope with returning to reality all of a sudden.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: No... The situation may be worse than you think. Her mental condition has affected her memories and even her Catalyst power.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: As for the cause of her mental instability, I'm afraid you'll have to find out more about it through interrogation, Chief.
Nightingale seems a little tense. But even after her preamble on Hamel's condition, when you enter the interrogation room, Hamel's confused state still surprises you.
Hamel...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Ch-chief...
She still seems unaccustomed to this title, clutching at the hem of her dress nervously.

Elegant, gentle, strong, kind... Your entire impression of her in the Carnival is now sealed under confusion and horror. You cannot imagine the kind of spiritual power one must pay as the price to subdue Corruptors...
We're all very grateful for your efforts, and we hope to help you find out the cause of your mental instability. If you don't like the format of this conversation, we can take it somewhere else.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You're all grateful?
Yes. You helped Hella and Hecate get rid of the darkness in their hearts. You suppressed the Corruptors, saving the FAC and the MBCC from depleting their forces. You've helped many people.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Me? ...I've helped you?
You really don't remember anything? In the Carnival, there were a Hamel who was your impersonator, three puppets who wished to protect your dance, and Parma with his subordinates in raincoats...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: My impersonator... Puppets...?
The sudden overflow of information is giving her nerves. She frowns, repeating your words while shaking her head constantly.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I, I don't remember. I only know I was dancing... I kept twirling and twirling...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: From the moment I stepped onto that dance floor to the moment I got woken up by you, decades seemed to have passed, and yet it also felt... as short as a blink of an eye.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Dancing, and dancing... That's the only clear memory I have from that dream.

options: Then do you still remember me?

choices.text: Then do you still remember me?

steps.content: The shackles are gleaming with a red light, sending warmth from your fingertips to her. Hamel merely looks down and gives a faint smile.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: It's a familiar and kind warmth... I wish I could remember what it is.
It seems like she's forgotten about you too.
I'll come back to get you!
This is not the end!
Dance for yourself!
I'll give you a stage!
Wait for me...
We still have a lot of time, you will remember everything... Right now, our priority is to find out the cause of your mental instability and help you adapt to the world outside the Ring.
You still remain gentle and patient, but you can't help feeling a little down. You've fulfilled the promise between the two of you, yet she's already forgotten it.
Still, Hamel captures your unexpressed frustration and disappointment.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I really want to help you, want to recall the story behind this red light, but... That voice has ripped open the past, too many memories are flooding out. I...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I can't find you in them fast enough...
Voice? What voice?
It could be what's disturbing Hamel's mind.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: The final words he left before leaving...
Hamel's gaze falls upon the evidence bag beside your hand.
I got it from an elderly man at the Carnival's gate. He said I could find your location with this...
At the bottom of the lake, I gave the pendant back to you, until you were rescued by the FAC.
What did you hear from it?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: An... elderly man?
Her voice sounds a little choked with sobs.
Yes, a white-haired old man. Why?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: No, nothing. It's just that I've forgotten that, time is not the only thing that ages people...
She lets out a soft sigh and smiles a little sorrowfully.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: It's him. He keeps repeating this to me, time after time...
Hamel cups the keepsake next to her ear.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: "I'm sorry, Sister, I can finally... meet you..."
Sister?
Before you have time to follow up with questions, a boy you've never seen before suddenly appears in the interrogation room.
Sister, quickly! Before they find us, I need to take you somewhere no one can find us!
The boy has a melancholic and immaculate air about him, seeming extremely determined as he speaks those words.
Don't worry, I'm young and full of strength. I can handle any job, delivering goods, pulling a rickshaw, I can do them all.
I know you're fed up with a life like this. You fear the stage. But as long as I'm here, no one can force you to dance.
This is?
The shackles have sensed the answer for you. This is an illusion Hamel has created with her ability.
The boy in the illusion has long blue hair and a pendant around his neck, looking strangely familiar.

options: Is that boy your younger brother?
That boy is the old man at the Carnival.

choices.text: Is that boy your younger brother?
That boy is the old man at the Carnival.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Yes, that's my story before I entered the Black Ring...
She stares at the pendant in her palm, her fingertip brushing the yellowed portrait of herself.
For Hamel, time has stopped with the Black Ring, so there hasn't been any changes in her appearance. But her younger brother, Norman, has become a white-haired old man...
Both time and talent have not treated the sister and brother fairly.

steps.speaker: Norman
steps.content: Never go on stage again! The doctor said you feared the stage! If you don't want to faint and trigger your illness again, listen to me!

steps.speaker: Norman
steps.content: I only want you to stay here, stay with me! You don't have to worry about money!

steps.speaker: Norman
steps.content: I'm doing all of this for your sake... It's all for you!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Norman... I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Norman
steps.content: You don't understand anything... What should I do... Please, what should I do...
The boy turns around in despair, a chasm separating him and his sister.
You seem to have had some arguments.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: His feet were entangled in mud, making him irritable.
By mud, do you mean stress from his daily life?
You are slowly catching up with the tempo of Hamel's expressions.
She nods, and with a wave of her hand, a new illusion unfolds.

steps.speaker: Younger Brother
steps.content: I won't have to worry about tomorrow's dinner... I won't have to bear the foreman's beating and swearing... I won't have to worry about Sister being taken away...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Norman... Where have you been today? You seem a bit strange...

steps.speaker: Younger Brother
steps.content: Don't worry, as soon as I step inside the Carnival, all my troubles will vanish...
In the illusory realm, Hamel pulls the boy back, trying to talk sense into him again and again...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: No, stop now!
She walks into the perilous carnival alone, pushing Norman away.
The marching crowd drowns her figure. With her dance, a brand new massive illusion unfolds, separating the siblings on the two sides of the new park's walls.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Leave this place, never come back inside...
The illusion fades, leaving only the sad message from Hamel's past echoing in the interrogation room.
The protagonist of the story looks down at the only keepsake in her hands, closing the locket gently.
That's why you stayed in the Black Ring?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: It was all because of me that he suffered so many troubles and became obsessed with the Carnival's bustle. To stop him from reentering that dangerous place, that was the only option I had.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I thought he could let go of the past and begin a new life of his own. But I'd overlooked that...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: As siblings, besides our appearances, we resemble each other in some other ways after all. Our stubbornness and persistence... I didn't expect he would linger outside the Carnival for so many years.
Who'd have guessed, that a missing Black Ring case that's impacted the DisCity for decades all started because a sister was trying to stop her brother from ruining his life?
The cause of awakening of the first publicly known Sinner is not some tale filled with intense grief or hatred. Rather, it is somewhat mundane?
I'm so sorry, your brother Norman...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I know, I can sense that... he's no longer alive, is he?
No. When the FAC eliminated all the Corruptors in the lake and brought you out, we double checked and found no other survivors.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I see... Perhaps the finale of the dance has already been written long ago.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I entered the Carnival because of Norman, and before I left the Carnival, I also heard... his final voices.
Her head bowed, her resigned and pitying eyes pass slowly over the marks left on the pendant by time.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: It's my fault...

options: It's all in the past now...

choices.text: It's all in the past now...

steps.content: It's the passing of her closest family. They've been missing each other but never seen for over twenty years. There are no words to console this kind of sorrow.
Before he left, he asked me to watch your dance in his stead. His wish was granted, I think he didn't suffer much when he passed away...
He's already gone. You should be freed from this as well.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Freed...?
No, she can't be freed yet...
Who's talking?

Buzz...
Before you can react, dizziness overcomes you and your ears are ringing, a new illusion taking over your entire vision.
Dark chaotic colors cover all the lights in the interrogation room. A phantom is extending its tentacles to envelope both of you.
You've seen this phantom before! In the vision you had in the dazed moment before the interrogation, in the audience facing the stage.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: No... It's...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: I'm a part of you. Your confusion, your perplexity, your loneliness, everything you see in your nightmares...
Nightmares? Could it be that what you saw before the interrogation was caused by the spiritual link of the shackles?
The phantom brushes your cheek as if with compassion.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: He has his own doubts, purposes, and desires. What about you? Hamel, what is your answer?
steps.female_content: She has her own doubts, purposes, and desires. What about you? Hamel, what is your answer?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I... I've already given my answer...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: The Carnival was dangerous... I, I could only...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: The Ring had shattered and Norman had left, you had no more reasons to stay... Why did you sacrifice yourself? Why did you dance with the Corruptors? You know it, you must know the answer...
The phantom approaches Hamel step by step. Though she is the owner of the illusory realm, Hamel can't stop its questioning and can only muffle her ears helplessly.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: It wasn't only for Norman. It wasn't only to trap the monsters in there. Say it, what is it that you've always desired! Why did you stay in the Carnival!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: What I desire... What do I desire...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: You're still feeling anxious, you're still confused, that's... why you've created me! You're not freed from this yet! You cannot be freed!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I don't know, I don't know...
Hamel keeps shaking her head. Your temples continue to hurt too.

options: Ask Hamel to end the illusion

choices.text: Ask Hamel to end the illusion

steps.content: Don't respond to it. Don't let that devilish voice in the illusion entice you.
Calm down. Breathe deeply. Forget what it said.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Norman... The reason I stayed in the Carnival... Ugh...
Your comforting words prove useless. Cradling her head, Hamel crouches on the chair in agony, repeating the phantom's questions.
If it's part of your emotions and your mind, then its existence depends on your illusions.
Continuing to use the Manic power will only worsen the chaos in your mind. Breathe deeply, end the illusion, make it go away.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I... I can't!
Cradling her head, Hamel crouches on the chair in agony.
Buzz... The ringing in your ears and the headache are coming back.
As expected, if you're to control a Catalyst Sinner with such great empathic power, you yourself must be burdened with a corresponding price.
The Sinner's shaken mind, the unstable empathic power, and the spiritual burden from the shackles. These three things make up a vicious cycle!
Hamel, end the illusion now!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: What is... this place? Where... should I go?
Hamel!
The red light from the shackles has banished the sticky phantom, but it's also tearing hard at your nerves at the same time.
Fortunately, the interrogation room has finally quieted down.
There are no Norman, no jellyfish-like phantom, no dancer from the past. Everything has only been a projection from Hamel's heart.
Voice a little dull, she's staring at your ashen face helplessly, hands pressing on her chest trying to steady her own breaths.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Was that... a part of me?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: It was questioning me? It... It hurt you...
I was briefly affected when your illusion went out of control.
Hamel lowers her head apologetically, her eyelashes dampened and fluttering slightly.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I want to tell you everything about myself, but there's another voice stuck in my chest constantly, thump, thump...
That means the voice causing your mental instability isn't Norman, but the numerous memories emerged after Norman's departure. Is something from your memories 23 years ago worsening your perplexity?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I can't make it clear... It won't recognize my answer. To question me, it even willingly takes on a physical form and appears in my nightmares and illusions all of a sudden...
Hamel's words have gotten even more abstract than before. You try to understand what she means.
Appears all of a sudden? The perplexity and loneliness signified by that phantom, have they only gotten exceptionally intense recently?

Judging from the time frame, it has to be directly related to her leaving the Carnival. The messy memories, leaving the Carnival, the perplexity and loneliness... The reason she stayed in the Black Ring is gradually becoming clear.
But looking at Hamel who's still in a daze, you realize it's not yet the right time to reveal everything. You can't further burden her fragile mind.
That phantom with a physical form said you were confused, perplexed, and lonely... But that's not your fault.
You managed to spend 23 years in the Black Ring, and have prevented Norman and more people from slipping into danger. You've already done an excellent job.
Hamel's brow is still tightly frowned.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Can I still find the answer today, 23 years later? The reason that even I myself have almost forgotten, the reason why I stayed in the Carnival...

I'm sure you can.
Unconscious thoughts usually reveal your true desires in your subconsciousness. I'll help you find the answer.
